resources.string: Phase 1: silently reject Indian numbers starting with +918697.
1. Select this app for call screening / caller ID and spam.\n2. Allow Contacts so Android also sends saved-contact calls for screening. The app does not read or upload your contacts.
Call screening is unavailable on this device.
Blocking is inactive. Enable call screening below.
Screening is active for unsaved callers. Allow Contacts to include your saved test number.
Ready: +918697… calls will be rejected, including saved contacts.

Lock your phone and call it from your test number. Matching calls are rejected with missed-call notifications suppressed; a blocked entry may remain in call history. Other numbers are allowed normally.

This rule blocks every Indian number beginning 8697. To stop blocking, change the caller ID / spam app in Default apps.

If Contacts was denied repeatedly, enable it under App permissions. WhatsApp calls are not screened.
